basic_info.description: Tucked in the heart of San Francisco's beloved Sunset District, just a block from the lively restaurants, cafes, and shops of Noriega Street, this sun-splashed home is the perfect blend of charm, functionality, and future potential. Inside, a gracious foyer invites you in and sets the tone for the rest of the home - bright, open, and full of character. The spacious living room welcomes you with natural light and a cozy corner fireplace, ideal for gathering or unwinding. Just beyond, the formal dining room boasts corner windows that frame partial views of the Golden Gate Bridge towers, adding a magical touch to every meal. The cheerful kitchen includes a sunny breakfast nook, a skylight overhead, and a picture window that also captures glimpses of the iconic bridge. Down the hallway, you'll find two generous bedrooms with ample closet space, one of which offers charming peek-a-boo ocean views, a gentle reminder that Ocean Beach is just moments away. A remodeled full bath completes this level. Downstairs, a massive two-car garage provides incredible potential for expanding the living space, along with convenient access to the sweet backyard garden, perfect for outdoor dining, play, or planting something special. This move-in ready gem is as practical as it is inviting.
